title: Ewert Park Renovation Ribbon Cutting
seo_title: Ewert Park Renovation Ribbon Cutting in Joplin, MO
description: This ribbon cutting celebrates the reopening of Joplin's historic Ewert Park, one of the City's oldest parks, after a year of major upgrades. The renovated park includes a Splash Park with an Ice Ribbon ice-skating facility, an ADA-accessible playground, covered basketball and pickleball courts with an amphitheater, and interpretive signage about the park's history. It takes place on December 17, 2026 (Time TBD) at Ewert Park, 615 S. Murphy Blvd in Joplin, MO.
